answer: Because the timing is written down against the pearl challenge, the marble audit can replay the thread history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 234 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The per-identity price is 98 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
